recipes.title: 蒜香奶油蝦
recipes.description: 蒜香奶油蝦 - garlic butter prawns. (Same dish as the 'Whole shrimp garlic butter' entry.)
ingredients: 明蝦 / Large prawns, 1 catty (~8-10 pcs)
帕馬森起司 / Parmesan cheese, a little
歐芹碎 / Chopped parsley, a little
steps: Prep the prawns: trim the whiskers, pull the head to remove the vein, and cut the belly down to the bottom so they peel easily when eaten; pat dry.
Heat a pan with the olive oil and butter, add the minced garlic, and stir on low heat until fragrant; arrange the prawns, sear briefly, then pour in the white wine, cover, and simmer 2 minutes.
Open the lid, flip the prawns, add the heavy cream, and season with salt and black pepper; reduce slightly, plate, and garnish with shaved parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: 魚湯
recipes.description: 大眼雞魚湯 - bigeye fish soup with tomato and root vegetables.
ingredients: 大眼雞魚仔 / Bigeye scad, 1 catty
steps: Clean the fish and pat the surface dry; pan-fry both sides over low heat with the ginger, then stir-fry the fish a bit more.
Add boiling water and cook on medium-low about 15 minutes.
Scoop out the fish and strain the broth.
Add the tomato, potato, carrot, and onion to the broth and boil another 15-20 minutes (until the potato and carrot are soft).
Salt to taste (saltier if serving with rice noodles or over rice).
